{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "R&D expenses scaled by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in R&D may experience future growth and profitability, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Operational Leverage", "construction": "The ratio of selling, general, and administrative expenses to total revenues, calculated as a 5-year average", "rationale": "Firms with high operational leverage may be more sensitive to changes in revenue, leading to higher returns in expanding markets. This measure reflects a firm's ability to scale its operations.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Ratio", "construction": "The ratio of pension assets to pension liabilities, calculated from the most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pensions may be less likely to experience financial distress, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage its long-term obligations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "The ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, calculated from the most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with significant environmental liabilities may face future costs and regulatory risks, leading to lower returns. This measure reflects a firm's exposure to environmental risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Diversification", "construction": "The Herfindahl index of product segments, calculated from the most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with diversified product offerings may be less susceptible to industry-specific shocks, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage its product risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Dispersion", "construction": "The ratio of foreign sales to total sales, calculated as a 3-year average", "rationale": "Firms with significant foreign sales may be more exposed to global growth opportunities, leading to higher returns. This measure reflects a firm's ability to access new markets.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Labor Union Coverage", "construction": "The percentage of employees covered by collective bargaining agreements, calculated from the most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with high labor union coverage may face higher labor costs and reduced flexibility, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's exposure to labor risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "The ratio of advertising expenses to total sales, calculated as a 5-year average", "rationale": "Firms with efficient advertising strategies may be more effective at reaching their target markets, leading to higher returns. This measure reflects a firm's ability to manage its marketing efforts.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "The number of suppliers and vendors reported in the most recent annual report, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may be more vulnerable to disruptions and logistics risks, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's exposure to operational risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Index", "construction": "A composite index of board independence, executive compensation, and shareholder rights, calculated from the most recent proxy statement", "rationale": "Firms with strong corporate governance practices may be more likely to prioritize shareholder value, leading to higher returns. This measure reflects a firm's commitment to good governance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
